risk_note: RV2 settlement (B2-09zm; BR-FUND-04; D10-1402, D10-1409; contract CT-24zzj). listAdminSettleBills now applies the optional awaiting_confirm filter (previously validated but ignored), and the workbench card settle_bill_pending gets a per-app read-only count countSettleBillPending(db, appId) exported from settlement/index.ts. One judgement only: settleBillAwaitingConfirm(generatedAt, batches) = generated_at not null and the latest round (unchanged latestRound: the main batches one round, each supplement launch by platform and creation instant another; tie by largest batch_id) has a DRAFT batch. deriveAdminSettleBill's issued/DRAFT branch, the list filter (after derivation and status, before paging; total = filtered count; rows identical to the unfiltered ones) and the count all call it; no clock. Batches are read by the shared readSettleRoundBatches (same SQL as before, microsecond created_at). Read only, no write, no audit, no amount. Behaviour without awaiting_confirm is unchanged. No migration, no contract change.

reviews.note: Codex via tools/agent/codex-run.sh, reasoning effort medium, base the branch point with main: pass, no findings; the checklist items are n/a (read-only list filter and count, no amounts, no posting).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests (10, test/spec/settlement/settle-bill-pending-count/) by Codex (test phase). The spec-test review is by a fresh independent Claude: an in-session Opus subagent of the desktop lane, read-only, not the implementing context (claude-run.sh's terminal accounts are logged out, D10-1448). r1 pass with two S2 gaps (filtered rows not compared field by field with the unfiltered ones; same-instant tie between rounds with several batches); the implementation satisfies both (rows from the same billView; latestRound keeps the largest-batch_id tie-break) and its unit tests cover the tie-break.
